title: Quotation

purpose.en: Make the price offer for one customer from inquiries that Pro-Cost has priced, send it to the customer, record follow-ups, and close it as WIN, LOST or Cancelled. Open it when an inquiry is Ready to Quote.
purpose.id: Membuat penawaran harga untuk satu customer dari inquiry yang sudah dihitung Pro-Cost, mengirimnya ke customer, mencatat follow-up, lalu menutupnya sebagai WIN, LOST atau Cancelled. Buka saat inquiry sudah Ready to Quote.

keywords: quotation, quo, penawaran, penawaran harga, offer, win, lost, customer setuju, ready to quote, follow up customer

steps.en: Click + New Record, then double-click an inquiry that is Ready to Quote (priced by Pro-Cost and not yet in another quotation).
steps.id: Klik + New Record, lalu klik dua kali inquiry yang berstatus Ready to Quote (sudah dihitung Pro-Cost dan belum masuk quotation lain).

steps.en: Tick the other inquiries of the same customer that are quoted together, then click Buat Quotation. A Draft is created with one line per qty tier.
steps.id: Centang inquiry lain milik customer yang sama yang ditawarkan bersama, lalu klik Buat Quotation. Draft terbentuk dengan satu baris per jenjang qty.

steps.en: In the Draft, check the header (Attn, CC, Sales PIC, dates, Currency, Payment Terms, Tax scheme) and edit the Details lines if needed, then click Save.
steps.id: Di Draft, cek header (Attn, CC, Sales PIC, tanggal, Currency, Payment Terms, Tax scheme) dan ubah baris Details bila perlu, lalu klik Save.

steps.en: Use + Add Inquiry to add more inquiries of the same customer, or + Add Row for a free line. Delete removes a Draft and the inquiries go back to Ready to Quote.
steps.id: Pakai + Add Inquiry untuk menambah inquiry lain milik customer yang sama, atau + Add Row untuk baris bebas. Delete menghapus Draft dan inquiry kembali ke Ready to Quote.

steps.en: Click Confirm to issue the quotation. It becomes locked. Click Print to produce the document for the customer.
steps.id: Klik Confirm untuk menerbitkan quotation. Dokumen terkunci. Klik Print untuk membuat dokumen yang dikirim ke customer.

steps.en: After every call, visit, WhatsApp or email to the customer, click + Add Follow-up and record the result and the next action.
steps.id: Setiap selesai telepon, kunjungan, WhatsApp atau email ke customer, klik + Add Follow-up dan catat hasil serta tindak lanjutnya.

steps.en: When the customer decides, click WIN - Buat Customer Order (creates the Customer Order), LOST (reason required) or Cancel (reason required).
steps.id: Saat customer sudah memutuskan, klik WIN - Buat Customer Order (membuat Customer Order), LOST (alasan wajib) atau Cancel (alasan wajib).

fields.label: No. Quotation
fields.en: Quotation number, given by the system when the Draft is created. Not typed.
fields.id: Nomor quotation, diberikan sistem saat Draft dibuat. Tidak diketik.

fields.label: Document date
fields.en: Date of the quotation. Changing it moves Valid Until and Deadline jawaban automatically.
fields.id: Tanggal quotation. Bila diubah, Valid Until dan Deadline jawaban ikut bergeser otomatis.

fields.label: Customer
fields.en: Follows the chosen inquiries and cannot be typed. One quotation is for one customer; a different customer needs a new quotation.
fields.id: Mengikuti inquiry yang dipilih dan tidak bisa diketik. Satu quotation untuk satu customer; customer lain butuh quotation baru.

fields.label: Attn (contact)
fields.en: Contact person of the customer who receives the quotation. Picked from the customer's contacts.
fields.id: Kontak di customer yang menerima quotation. Dipilih dari daftar kontak customer.

fields.label: CC
fields.en: Other customer contacts who also receive a copy. More than one can be picked.
fields.id: Kontak customer lain yang juga menerima tembusan. Boleh lebih dari satu.

fields.label: Sales PIC
fields.en: Sales person responsible for this quotation. Picked from the sales person list.
fields.id: Sales yang bertanggung jawab atas quotation ini. Dipilih dari daftar sales.

fields.label: Valid Until
fields.en: Last date the offer is valid. Filled automatically as 30 days after the document date; can be changed.
fields.id: Tanggal terakhir penawaran berlaku. Terisi otomatis 30 hari setelah tanggal dokumen; boleh diubah.

fields.label: Deadline jawaban
fields.en: Date by which the customer should answer. Filled automatically as 14 days after the document date; can be changed.
fields.id: Tanggal batas customer menjawab. Terisi otomatis 14 hari setelah tanggal dokumen; boleh diubah.

fields.label: Currency
fields.en: Currency of the offer, picked from the currency master. It sets the currency symbol and the amount in words.
fields.id: Mata uang penawaran, dipilih dari master currency. Menentukan simbol mata uang dan terbilang.

fields.label: Payment Terms
fields.en: Payment term printed on the quotation, picked from the payment term master.
fields.id: Syarat pembayaran yang tercetak di quotation, dipilih dari master payment term.

fields.label: Tax scheme
fields.en: Exclusive PPN 11% (tax added on top) or Inclusive PPN 11% (tax inside the price). Used for DPP, PPN and Grand Total.
fields.id: Exclusive PPN 11% (pajak ditambahkan di atas harga) atau Inclusive PPN 11% (pajak sudah di dalam harga). Dipakai untuk DPP, PPN dan Grand Total.

fields.label: Notes for the customer (printed)
fields.en: Free text that is printed on the quotation for the customer.
fields.id: Teks bebas yang ikut tercetak di quotation untuk customer.

fields.label: Uraian
fields.en: Description of a line. Filled from the inquiry (one line per qty tier, and one tooling line); can be edited while the quotation is a Draft.
fields.id: Uraian satu baris. Terisi dari inquiry (satu baris per jenjang qty, ditambah satu baris tooling); bisa diubah selama Draft.

fields.label: Qty
fields.en: Quantity offered on the line. Prefilled from the qty tier of the inquiry; editable in Draft.
fields.id: Jumlah yang ditawarkan di baris. Terisi dari jenjang qty inquiry; bisa diubah saat Draft.

fields.label: Unit
fields.en: Unit of the quantity, for example pcs.
fields.id: Satuan jumlah, misalnya pcs.

fields.label: Unit price
fields.en: Selling price per unit. Prefilled from the price published by Pro-Cost; editable in Draft.
fields.id: Harga jual per satuan. Terisi dari harga yang sudah dipublish Pro-Cost; bisa diubah saat Draft.

fields.label: Disc %
fields.en: Discount percentage of the line. Usually empty because discounts are occasional.
fields.id: Persen diskon baris. Biasanya kosong karena diskon jarang diberikan.

fields.label: Subtotal
fields.en: Line amount after discount. Calculated by the system, not typed.
fields.id: Jumlah baris setelah diskon. Dihitung sistem, tidak diketik.

fields.label: Line Source
fields.en: Shows where the line came from: the inquiry number and whether it is a qty tier or tooling line, or a free line.
fields.id: Menunjukkan asal baris: nomor inquiry dan apakah jenjang qty atau tooling, atau baris bebas.

fields.label: Follow-up: Type
fields.en: In + Add Follow-up: how the customer was contacted (Telepon, Kunjungan, WhatsApp, Email, Meeting or Lainnya).
fields.id: Di + Add Follow-up: cara menghubungi customer (Telepon, Kunjungan, WhatsApp, Email, Meeting atau Lainnya).

fields.label: Follow-up: Result
fields.en: Outcome of the contact: Positif, Netral, Negatif or Tidak terhubung. Together with Date, Contact and Notes it is kept in the follow-up log.
fields.id: Hasil kontak: Positif, Netral, Negatif atau Tidak terhubung. Bersama Date, Contact dan Notes tersimpan di log follow-up.

fields.label: Follow-up date
fields.en: Date of the next action, with Tindak lanjut apa describing it. It feeds the Follow-up Quotation and Open Quotations reports.
fields.id: Tanggal tindak lanjut berikutnya, dengan Tindak lanjut apa sebagai penjelasannya. Muncul di laporan Follow-up Quotation dan Quotation Terbuka.

fields.label: Cancellation reason
fields.en: Required when you click Cancel on an issued quotation. The inquiries can be quoted again afterwards.
fields.id: Wajib diisi saat klik Cancel pada quotation yang sudah terbit. Inquiry-nya bisa ditawarkan lagi setelahnya.

fields.label: Reason lost (price, time, competitor, ...)
fields.en: Required when you click LOST. It is kept on the inquiry and shown in the Win-Rate Sales report.
fields.id: Wajib diisi saat klik LOST. Tersimpan di inquiry dan tampil di laporan Win-Rate Sales.

title: All Inquiries

purpose.en: Worklist of every inquiry (New, Revise and Recalc) with its stage. Use it to find an inquiry, see where it is in the flow, or start a new one through the wizard.
purpose.id: Daftar kerja semua inquiry (New, Revise dan Recalc) beserta tahapnya. Dipakai untuk mencari inquiry, melihat posisinya dalam alur, atau memulai inquiry baru lewat wizard.

keywords: inquiry, inkuiri, all inquiries, semua inquiry, worklist inquiry, permintaan harga, new product, recalculate price, change specification, wizard

steps.en: Pick a tab (New Product, Recalculate Price, Change Specification) or a stage filter (Draft, Ready to Quote, Pro-Dev, Pro-Cost) to narrow the list.
steps.id: Pilih tab (New Product, Recalculate Price, Change Specification) atau filter tahap (Draft, Ready to Quote, Pro-Dev, Pro-Cost) untuk mempersempit daftar.

steps.en: Double-click a row. A Draft opens for editing; any other inquiry opens view-only in the screen of its type.
steps.id: Klik dua kali satu baris. Draft terbuka untuk diedit; inquiry lain terbuka hanya untuk dilihat di layar sesuai jenisnya.

steps.en: Click + New Record to start the wizard. Step 1: choose the type. New Product opens the blank form straight away.
steps.id: Klik + New Record untuk memulai wizard. Langkah 1: pilih jenis. New Product langsung membuka form kosong.

steps.en: For Recalculate Price or Change Specification, step 2 asks for the source: choose Dari Inquiry Lama, then pick the source inquiry in step 3.
steps.id: Untuk Recalculate Price atau Change Specification, langkah 2 menanyakan sumber: pilih Dari Inquiry Lama, lalu pilih inquiry sumber di langkah 3.

steps.en: Fill the opened form and Confirm it. Then follow the Stage column until the inquiry is Ready to Quote and can go into a Quotation.
steps.id: Isi form yang terbuka lalu Confirm. Setelah itu pantau kolom Stage sampai inquiry Ready to Quote dan bisa masuk Quotation.

fields.label: Inquiry No. / Customer
fields.en: Inquiry number with the customer name (or the prospect name). Numbered when the inquiry is first saved.
fields.id: Nomor inquiry beserta nama customer (atau nama prospek). Nomor diberikan saat inquiry pertama kali disimpan.

fields.label: Date
fields.en: Date of the inquiry.
fields.id: Tanggal inquiry.

fields.label: Product
fields.en: Draft product name typed by Sales.
fields.id: Nama produk sementara yang diketik Sales.

fields.label: Product Type
fields.en: Dieline product type of the first part.
fields.id: Tipe produk (dieline) dari part pertama.

fields.label: Main tier qty
fields.en: The qty tier marked as main (Utama) in the inquiry.
fields.id: Jenjang qty yang ditandai Utama di inquiry.

fields.label: Type
fields.en: NEW (new product), RECALC (same product, new price) or REVISE (specification changed).
fields.id: NEW (produk baru), RECALC (produk sama, harga baru) atau REVISE (spesifikasi berubah).

fields.label: Stage
fields.en: Where the inquiry is: Draft, Pro-Dev, Pro-Cost or Ready to Quote. A cancelled, lost or converted inquiry shows that status instead.
fields.id: Posisi inquiry: Draft, Pro-Dev, Pro-Cost atau Ready to Quote. Inquiry yang dibatalkan, kalah atau sudah menjadi order menampilkan statusnya.

fields.label: Status
fields.en: Document status of the inquiry. Hidden by default; add it from the column list.
fields.id: Status dokumen inquiry. Tersembunyi secara bawaan; tambahkan dari daftar kolom.

fields.label: PIC Sales
fields.en: Sales person responsible. Hidden by default; used as a filter.
fields.id: Sales yang bertanggung jawab. Tersembunyi secara bawaan; dipakai sebagai filter.

fields.label: Quotation deadline
fields.en: Date by which the quotation should be ready. Hidden by default.
fields.id: Tanggal quotation harus siap. Tersembunyi secara bawaan.

fields.label: Status, Customer, PIC Sales (filters)
fields.en: Filters to narrow the list by document status, customer or Sales PIC.
fields.id: Filter untuk mempersempit daftar menurut status dokumen, customer atau PIC Sales.

fields.label: Create Inquiry - Step 1: choose the type
fields.en: Wizard dialog opened by + New Record. Choose New, Recalc or Revise. Dari Master Produk is shown as Segera (not active yet).
fields.id: Dialog wizard yang dibuka + New Record. Pilih New, Recalc atau Revise. Dari Master Produk tampil sebagai Segera (belum aktif).

title: Inquiry New

purpose.en: Sales desk for New Product inquiries: a customer asks for a product that does not exist yet. Enter the specification here, Confirm it, and it goes to Pro-Dev New.
purpose.id: Meja Sales untuk inquiry Produk Baru: customer meminta produk yang belum ada. Isi spesifikasinya di sini, Confirm, lalu inquiry masuk ke Pro-Dev New.

keywords: inquiry new, inkuiri baru, produk baru, new product, permintaan harga baru, spesifikasi produk, dieline, tier qty, part

steps.en: Click + New Record. The Inquiry New form opens directly, without a type pop-up. Existing inquiries are opened by double-click.
steps.id: Klik + New Record. Form Inquiry New langsung terbuka tanpa pop-up pilih jenis. Inquiry yang sudah ada dibuka dengan klik dua kali.

steps.en: Fill the header: date, need date, PIC Sales, Source, Customer, Product Name, then choose Product Category, Category Detail and Standard Size.
steps.id: Isi header: tanggal, tanggal kebutuhan, PIC Sales, Source, Customer, Product Name, lalu pilih Product Category, Category Detail dan Standard Size.

steps.en: Enter the qty tiers and mark exactly one as Utama (main). Then fill each part: name, role, type, dimensions, materials, colours and finishing.
steps.id: Isi jenjang qty dan tandai tepat satu sebagai Utama. Lalu isi tiap part: nama, peran, tipe, dimensi, bahan, warna dan finishing.

steps.en: Add tooling lines and external costs if they are already known, then click Save. The inquiry gets its number and stays a Draft.
steps.id: Tambahkan baris tooling dan biaya eksternal bila sudah diketahui, lalu klik Save. Inquiry mendapat nomor dan tetap berstatus Draft.

steps.en: Click Confirm. The form is locked and the inquiry appears in Pro-Dev New. Artwork can still be uploaded after Confirm.
steps.id: Klik Confirm. Form terkunci dan inquiry muncul di Pro-Dev New. Artwork masih bisa diunggah setelah Confirm.

steps.en: After Confirm you can still use Cancel (reason required) or Mark Lost (reason required). Duplicate copies the specification to another customer as a new Draft.
steps.id: Setelah Confirm masih ada Cancel (alasan wajib) atau Mark Lost (alasan wajib). Duplicate menyalin spesifikasi ke customer lain sebagai Draft baru.

fields.label: Inquiry No.
fields.en: Inquiry number, shown as automatic until the first Save.
fields.id: Nomor inquiry, tertulis otomatis sampai Save pertama.

fields.label: Date
fields.en: Date of the inquiry. Today by default.
fields.id: Tanggal inquiry. Bawaannya hari ini.

fields.label: Customer Need Date
fields.en: Date the customer needs the answer or the product. Filled as 14 days from today; can be changed.
fields.id: Tanggal customer membutuhkan jawaban atau produk. Terisi 14 hari dari hari ini; boleh diubah.

fields.label: Sales PIC
fields.en: Sales person who owns the inquiry, picked from the sales person master. Recorded as the basis for commission.
fields.id: Sales pemilik inquiry, dipilih dari master sales. Tercatat sebagai dasar komisi.

fields.label: Source
fields.en: How the inquiry arrived: EMAIL, WA, PHONE, VISIT or MARKETPLACE.
fields.id: Dari mana inquiry masuk: EMAIL, WA, PHONE, VISIT atau MARKETPLACE.

fields.label: Customer
fields.en: Customer from the customer master (required). A new customer can be created from the picker; it starts as a Draft customer that Finance still reviews.
fields.id: Customer dari master customer (wajib). Customer baru bisa dibuat dari pemilih; statusnya Draft dan masih direview Finance.

fields.label: Product Name (draft)
fields.en: Temporary product name used during the quotation (required, max 150 characters). Special characters such as / @ # % are not allowed.
fields.id: Nama produk sementara selama proses quotation (wajib, maks 150 karakter). Karakter khusus seperti / @ # % tidak boleh.

fields.label: Product Category
fields.en: Category from Master Product Market (required). Choose Custom if the product is not in the list.
fields.id: Kategori dari Master Product Market (wajib). Pilih Custom bila produk belum ada di daftar.

fields.label: Category Detail
fields.en: Detail under the chosen category (required). It fills the Product Type automatically.
fields.id: Detail di bawah kategori yang dipilih (wajib). Mengisi Product Type secara otomatis.

fields.label: Standard Size
fields.en: Common market size of the chosen detail (required). It fills the dimensions of all parts.
fields.id: Ukuran pasaran dari detail yang dipilih (wajib). Mengisi dimensi semua part.

fields.label: Product Type (international dieline)
fields.en: Dieline type of the product. Automatic from Category Detail; for a Custom product choose the closest dieline.
fields.id: Tipe dieline produk. Otomatis dari Category Detail; untuk produk Custom pilih dieline yang paling mirip.

fields.label: Custom Product Name
fields.en: Shown only when Custom is chosen. Name of the product that is not yet in Master Product Market.
fields.id: Hanya tampil bila Custom dipilih. Nama produk yang belum ada di Master Product Market.

fields.label: Sales Notes
fields.en: Optional free note from Sales for the next desks.
fields.id: Catatan bebas dari Sales untuk bagian berikutnya (opsional).

fields.label: Material Source
fields.en: Tick when the customer supplies its own raw material. Unticked means the company buys the material and the order is a product order.
fields.id: Centang bila customer menyediakan bahan baku sendiri. Tidak dicentang berarti bahan dibeli perusahaan dan order berupa produk.

fields.label: Customer material description
fields.en: Shown when the customer supplies material (required then). Describe the material, for example type, gsm, size and quantity.
fields.id: Tampil bila bahan dari customer (wajib saat itu). Jelaskan bahannya, misalnya jenis, gramatur, ukuran dan jumlah.

fields.label: Material ETA
fields.en: Expected arrival date of the customer's material.
fields.id: Perkiraan tanggal bahan dari customer tiba.

fields.label: Qty (pcs)
fields.en: Order quantity of one tier. Add as many tiers as the customer wants priced.
fields.id: Jumlah order satu jenjang. Tambah jenjang sebanyak yang ingin dihitung harganya oleh customer.

fields.label: Main
fields.en: Marks the main tier. Exactly one tier must be Utama.
fields.id: Menandai jenjang utama. Harus tepat satu jenjang yang Utama.

fields.label: Part Name
fields.en: Name of the part, for example Body or Lid. It fills automatically when a part role is chosen with the tag icon.
fields.id: Nama part, misalnya Body atau Lid. Terisi otomatis saat peran part dipilih lewat ikon tag.

fields.label: Choose Part Role
fields.en: Role of the part (Body, Lid, Base, Sleeve, Tray, Insert, Divider, Left, Right, MonoForm). Required before dimensions and the dieline preview open.
fields.id: Peran part (Body, Lid, Base, Sleeve, Tray, Insert, Divider, Left, Right, MonoForm). Wajib dipilih sebelum dimensi dan pratinjau dieline aktif.

fields.label: Part Type
fields.en: Material family of the part: Paper, Paper + Sheet, Paper + SF, Sheet or Kraft.
fields.id: Jenis bahan part: Paper, Paper + Sheet, Paper + SF, Sheet atau Kraft.

fields.label: Qty per Set
fields.en: How many pieces of this part go into one finished product.
fields.id: Berapa lembar part ini dalam satu produk jadi.

fields.label: Qty per Pack (pcs)
fields.en: Number of finished pieces in one pack, for example 400.
fields.id: Jumlah produk jadi dalam satu pak, misalnya 400.

fields.label: Artwork / Design (outer)
fields.en: Outer artwork image (jpg or png). It is placed on the dieline preview and can be uploaded again after Confirm.
fields.id: Gambar artwork sisi luar (jpg atau png). Ditempatkan di pratinjau dieline dan bisa diunggah ulang setelah Confirm.

fields.label: Inner Side Artwork (optional)
fields.en: Inner side artwork for two-sided printing. Shown on the Sisi Dalam tab of the dieline preview.
fields.id: Artwork sisi dalam untuk cetak dua sisi. Tampil di tab Sisi Dalam pratinjau dieline.

fields.label: Dieline dimensions
fields.en: Product dimensions of the part, entered in the dieline panel. The live dieline and the flat size update while you type.
fields.id: Dimensi produk part, diisi di panel dieline. Dieline dan ukuran bentangan ikut berubah saat Anda mengetik.

fields.label: Type
fields.en: Material row: material type picked from the material master. Row #1 is always Paper, row #2 is Sheet/SF; + Tambah Bahan adds an extra layer.
fields.id: Baris bahan: jenis bahan dari master bahan. Baris #1 selalu Paper, baris #2 Sheet/SF; + Tambah Bahan menambah lapisan.

fields.label: Grammage / Spec
fields.en: Grammage or specification of the material. Brand and plano size are decided later by Purchasing and Pro-Dev.
fields.id: Gramatur atau spesifikasi bahan. Merek dan ukuran plano ditentukan belakangan oleh Purchasing dan Pro-Dev.

fields.label: Colour Notation
fields.en: Colours as front/back, from 1/0 to 6/6 (for example 4/4). The front, back and total colours are derived automatically.
fields.id: Warna dalam format depan/belakang, dari 1/0 sampai 6/6 (misalnya 4/4). Jumlah warna depan, belakang dan total dihitung otomatis.

fields.label: Colour Note (Pantone)
fields.en: Free note about special colours, for example Pantone 485 C.
fields.id: Catatan bebas tentang warna khusus, misalnya Pantone 485 C.

fields.label: Finishing Type
fields.en: Optional decorative process (hot print, UV spot, emboss, lamination). More than one can be added, with Atribut / Varian describing the detail.
fields.id: Proses dekoratif tambahan (opsional): hot print, UV spot, emboss, laminasi. Boleh lebih dari satu, dengan Atribut / Varian untuk detailnya.

fields.label: Tooling (Type, Status, New Cost?, Cost (Rp), Notes)
fields.en: Tooling lines: plate, die or film, whether it exists or is worn, and whether it is a new charge. A new charge flows into the quotation.
fields.id: Baris tooling: plat, pisau atau film, apakah ada atau aus, dan apakah biaya baru. Biaya baru ikut mengalir ke quotation.

fields.label: External / Third-Party Costs
fields.en: Known third-party costs (trucking, expedition, outside service) with Type, Amount (IDR) and Tax Treatment. They flow into the quotation and the order.
fields.id: Biaya pihak ketiga yang sudah pasti (trucking, ekspedisi, jasa luar) dengan Type, Amount (IDR) dan Tax Treatment. Mengalir ke quotation dan order.

fields.label: Assembly (combined parts)
fields.en: After at least two parts are saved, combine them into an assembly: Assembly name, Join type, Qty of each part, and the parts to combine.
fields.id: Setelah minimal dua part tersimpan, gabungkan menjadi rakitan: Assembly name, Join type, jumlah tiap part, dan part yang digabung.

title: Inquiry Revise

purpose.en: Change the specification of a product that already exists in Master Product (artwork, colour, size, material, process or join). A revision creates a derived product; the parent stays untouched.
purpose.id: Mengubah spesifikasi produk yang sudah ada di Master Product (artwork, warna, ukuran, bahan, proses atau sambungan). Revisi membuat produk turunan; produk induk tetap utuh.

keywords: inquiry revise, revisi, revision, ubah spesifikasi, change specification, produk turunan, scope revisi, perubahan artwork, ganti ukuran

steps.en: Open the list of Revise documents. Click + New Record, then double-click the Master Product that you want to revise.
steps.id: Buka daftar dokumen Revise. Klik + New Record, lalu klik dua kali Master Product yang akan direvisi.

steps.en: Type the Revision reason and tick the Revision scope. Only the blocks of the ticked scopes can be edited.
steps.id: Ketik Revision reason dan centang Revision scope. Hanya blok dari scope yang dicentang yang bisa diubah.

steps.en: Change the fields in the open blocks (artwork, dimensions, materials, colours, finishing or join type) for each part.
steps.id: Ubah isian di blok yang terbuka (artwork, dimensi, bahan, warna, finishing atau sambungan) untuk tiap part.

steps.en: Click Save. The Revision differences table records before and after for every changed field; Pro-Dev and Pro-Cost see it too.
steps.id: Klik Save. Tabel Revision differences mencatat nilai sebelum dan sesudah tiap field yang berubah; Pro-Dev dan Pro-Cost juga melihatnya.

steps.en: Click Confirm. The form is locked and the revision goes to Pro-Dev Revise, then Pro-Cost Revise, then it is ready for Quotation.
steps.id: Klik Confirm. Form terkunci dan revisi masuk ke Pro-Dev Revise, lalu Pro-Cost Revise, kemudian siap untuk Quotation.

steps.en: A Draft can be deleted. After Confirm only Cancel (reason required) is possible. Duplicate copies the specification to another customer.
steps.id: Draft bisa dihapus. Setelah Confirm hanya Cancel (alasan wajib) yang bisa dilakukan. Duplicate menyalin spesifikasi ke customer lain.

fields.label: Revision reason
fields.en: Why the product is revised, for example a customer artwork change (required).
fields.id: Alasan produk direvisi, misalnya customer mengganti artwork (wajib).

fields.label: New Design No.
fields.en: Design number of the derived product. Prefilled with the parent design number.
fields.id: Nomor desain produk turunan. Terisi dengan nomor desain produk induk.

fields.label: Revision scope (more than one allowed) - only the selected blocks can be changed
fields.en: Tick what changes: Artwork, Warna, Dimensi, Bahan, Proses / Finishing, Struktur / Sambungan. Each scope unlocks one block below.
fields.id: Centang yang berubah: Artwork, Warna, Dimensi, Bahan, Proses / Finishing, Struktur / Sambungan. Tiap scope membuka satu blok di bawah.

fields.label: Join type
fields.en: Join type of an assembly part, picked from the join master. Open only with the Struktur / Sambungan scope.
fields.id: Jenis sambungan part rakitan, dipilih dari master sambungan. Terbuka hanya dengan scope Struktur / Sambungan.

fields.label: New artwork (outside)
fields.en: New outer artwork image (jpg or png). Open only with the Artwork scope; a new artwork needs Digital ACC again.
fields.id: Gambar artwork luar yang baru (jpg atau png). Terbuka hanya dengan scope Artwork; artwork baru perlu ACC Digital lagi.

fields.label: New artwork (inside)
fields.en: New inner artwork image. Open only with the Artwork scope.
fields.id: Gambar artwork dalam yang baru. Terbuka hanya dengan scope Artwork.

fields.label: Dimensi (mm)
fields.en: Product length (P), width (L) and height (T) of the part. Open only with the Dimensi scope.
fields.id: Panjang (P), lebar (L) dan tinggi (T) produk part. Terbuka hanya dengan scope Dimensi.

fields.label: Bahan #1
fields.en: Material of the part, picked from the material categories (one field per material layer). Open only with the Bahan scope.
fields.id: Bahan part, dipilih dari kategori bahan (satu isian per lapisan bahan). Terbuka hanya dengan scope Bahan.

fields.label: Colour notation
fields.en: Colours as front/back, for example 4/4. Open only with the Warna scope.
fields.id: Warna dalam format depan/belakang, misalnya 4/4. Terbuka hanya dengan scope Warna.

fields.label: Tinta
fields.en: Free note about ink, for example CMYK plus a Pantone spot. Open only with the Warna scope.
fields.id: Catatan bebas tentang tinta, misalnya CMYK ditambah spot Pantone. Terbuka hanya dengan scope Warna.

fields.label: Finishing
fields.en: Finishing processes of the part, ticked from the finishing list. Open only with the Proses / Finishing scope.
fields.id: Proses finishing part, dicentang dari daftar finishing. Terbuka hanya dengan scope Proses / Finishing.

fields.label: Cancellation reason
fields.en: Required when you Cancel a confirmed revision.
fields.id: Wajib diisi saat membatalkan revisi yang sudah di-Confirm.

title: Inquiry Recalc

purpose.en: Reorder of an existing Master Product with the same specification but a new price (for example material prices changed). Specification is locked; Sales only enters the new order qty.
purpose.id: Order ulang Master Product yang sudah ada dengan spesifikasi sama tetapi harga baru (misalnya harga bahan berubah). Spesifikasi terkunci; Sales hanya mengisi qty order baru.

keywords: inquiry recalc, rekalkulasi, recalculation, hitung ulang harga, recalculate price, order ulang, repeat order, harga bahan naik

steps.en: Open the list of Recalc documents. Click + New Record, then double-click the Master Product to recalculate.
steps.id: Buka daftar dokumen Recalc. Klik + New Record, lalu klik dua kali Master Product yang akan dihitung ulang.

steps.en: Check the order and selling price history to see what was sold before, at which price and qty.
steps.id: Cek riwayat order dan harga jual untuk melihat apa yang pernah terjual, dengan harga dan qty berapa.

steps.en: Enter the New order qty (pcs) and, if needed, the Deadline quotation. Specification, dieline, materials and processes are locked.
steps.id: Isi New order qty (pcs) dan bila perlu Deadline quotation. Spesifikasi, dieline, bahan dan proses terkunci.

steps.en: Click Save to keep a Draft. A Draft can be deleted. Click Confirm to lock it.
steps.id: Klik Save untuk menyimpan Draft. Draft bisa dihapus. Klik Confirm untuk mengunci.

steps.en: After Confirm the document goes straight to Pro-Cost Recalc, without Pro-Dev. After Pro-Cost publishes the price it is ready for Quotation.
steps.id: Setelah Confirm dokumen langsung ke Pro-Cost Recalc, tanpa Pro-Dev. Setelah Pro-Cost mempublish harga, siap untuk Quotation.

steps.en: After Confirm only Cancel (reason required) is possible. Use Inquiry Revise instead if the specification must change.
steps.id: Setelah Confirm hanya Cancel (alasan wajib) yang bisa dilakukan. Pakai Inquiry Revise bila spesifikasi harus berubah.

fields.label: Customer
fields.en: Owner customer of the Master Product. Shown only, cannot be changed.
fields.id: Customer pemilik Master Product. Hanya ditampilkan, tidak bisa diubah.

fields.label: Contact (attn)
fields.en: Contact of the latest quotation of this product. Shown only.
fields.id: Kontak pada quotation terakhir produk ini. Hanya ditampilkan.

fields.label: Sales PIC · Payment Term
fields.en: Sales person and payment term of the latest quotation. Shown only.
fields.id: Sales dan syarat bayar pada quotation terakhir. Hanya ditampilkan.

fields.label: New order qty (pcs)
fields.en: Quantity of the new order (required). It becomes the main qty tier of the inquiry. Prefilled with the qty of the last order.
fields.id: Jumlah order baru (wajib). Menjadi jenjang qty utama inquiry. Terisi dengan qty order terakhir.

fields.label: Deadline quotation
fields.en: Date by which the quotation should be ready (optional).
fields.id: Tanggal quotation harus siap (opsional).

fields.label: Order terakhir
fields.en: Latest won order of the product: Customer Order number, qty and date. Shown only.
fields.id: Order terakhir yang menang untuk produk ini: nomor Customer Order, qty dan tanggal. Hanya ditampilkan.

fields.label: Order & selling price history
fields.en: Table of earlier quotations and orders of the product with date, qty, selling price per pcs, result, qty tiers offered and shipments. Costing details are not shown here.
fields.id: Tabel quotation dan order terdahulu produk ini: tanggal, qty, harga jual per pcs, hasil, jenjang qty yang ditawarkan dan pengiriman. Rincian biaya tidak ditampilkan.

fields.label: Cancellation reason
fields.en: Required when you Cancel a confirmed recalculation.
fields.id: Wajib diisi saat membatalkan rekalkulasi yang sudah di-Confirm.

title: Pro-Dev New

purpose.en: Product development desk for New inquiries confirmed by Sales: find the cheapest physical layout (ups, plano, machine) and prepare BOM, ink and process. Confirm every part to pass the inquiry to Pro-Cost.
purpose.id: Meja pengembangan produk untuk inquiry New yang sudah di-Confirm Sales: mencari susunan cetak fisik paling hemat (up, plano, mesin) dan menyiapkan BOM, tinta dan proses. Confirm semua part agar inquiry lanjut ke Pro-Cost.

keywords: prodev, pro-dev new, product development, imposition, layout, up, plano, nesting, master card, bom, bop, ink, canvas, dieline

steps.en: Open the list. It shows inquiries confirmed by Sales; the default filter To Do shows those whose Pro-Dev is not finished.
steps.id: Buka daftar. Isinya inquiry yang sudah di-Confirm Sales; filter bawaan To Do menampilkan yang Pro-Dev-nya belum selesai.

steps.en: Double-click a row. The workbench opens for the first part not yet Confirmed; the master part is created at that moment if needed.
steps.id: Klik dua kali satu baris. Workbench terbuka untuk part pertama yang belum Confirmed; part master dibuat saat itu bila belum ada.

steps.en: On the Imposition tab set Jumlah Up (Auto Up or manual), Gap, Canvas limit and canvas size, then choose the printing machine, the die-cut machine and the plano.
steps.id: Di tab Imposition atur Jumlah Up (Auto Up atau manual), Gap, Canvas limit dan ukuran canvas, lalu pilih mesin cetak, mesin plong dan plano.

steps.en: Use Suggestion, Calculate Plano and Auto Nesting for a proposal, or drag the artworks by hand. The engine only suggests; you decide.
steps.id: Pakai Suggestion, Calculate Plano dan Auto Nesting untuk usulan, atau geser artwork dengan tangan. Sistem hanya menyarankan; Anda yang memutuskan.

steps.en: Check the sections Bill of Material, Ink Configuration and Bill of Process. Create a purchase request or a subcontract from the rows when needed.
steps.id: Cek bagian Bill of Material, Ink Configuration dan Bill of Process. Buat permintaan pembelian atau subkon dari baris bila diperlukan.

steps.en: On the Part & Dieline tab you may change dimensions, flat size or artwork, then Save. A warning appears if the layout is Confirmed or the costing is published.
steps.id: Di tab Part & Dieline Anda boleh mengubah dimensi, bentangan atau artwork, lalu Save. Peringatan muncul bila layout sudah Confirmed atau costing sudah dipublish.

steps.en: Click Save, then Confirm for the part. Repeat for every part. When all parts are Confirmed the inquiry is Done and appears in Pro-Cost.
steps.id: Klik Save, lalu Confirm untuk part tersebut. Ulangi untuk setiap part. Bila semua part Confirmed, inquiry berstatus Done dan muncul di Pro-Cost.

steps.en: Use Print to get the Master Card or the ACC Digital sheet, and Email to send them.
steps.id: Pakai Print untuk Master Card atau lembar ACC Digital, dan Email untuk mengirimnya.

fields.label: Inquiry No. / Customer
fields.en: Inquiry number with the customer name (list column).
fields.id: Nomor inquiry beserta nama customer (kolom daftar).

fields.label: Confirmed by Sales
fields.en: Date Sales confirmed the inquiry (list column). It is when the inquiry arrived in Pro-Dev.
fields.id: Tanggal Sales meng-Confirm inquiry (kolom daftar). Itu saat inquiry masuk ke Pro-Dev.

fields.label: Work
fields.en: To Do while some part is not Confirmed yet; Done when every part is Confirmed. Also a filter.
fields.id: To Do selama masih ada part yang belum Confirmed; Done bila semua part sudah Confirmed. Bisa dipakai sebagai filter.

fields.label: Confirmed by Pro-Dev
fields.en: Date Pro-Dev confirmed all parts (list column).
fields.id: Tanggal Pro-Dev meng-Confirm semua part (kolom daftar).

fields.label: Auto Up
fields.en: On: the system uses the highest number of ups that fit and shows the optimised result. Off: you type Target up (manual) and the smallest canvas that holds it is found.
fields.id: Aktif: sistem memakai jumlah up terbanyak yang muat dan menampilkan hasil optimasi. Mati: Anda mengetik Target up (manual) dan dicarikan canvas terkecil yang memuatnya.

fields.label: Gap
fields.en: Distance between artworks or dielines on the sheet, in cm.
fields.id: Jarak antar artwork atau dieline di lembar, dalam cm.

fields.label: Canvas limit
fields.en: Limit of the canvas: Custom (follow dieline, no machine limit), Press bed, Die-cut bed (Pond) or Press + Die-cut (the smaller of both).
fields.id: Batas canvas: Custom (ikut dieline, tanpa batas mesin), Press bed, Die-cut bed (Pond) atau Press + Die-cut (yang terkecil dari keduanya).

fields.label: Length (cm)
fields.en: Length of the print canvas in cm. Width (cm) is the width. Both can be typed or filled by Suggestion.
fields.id: Panjang canvas cetak dalam cm. Width (cm) adalah lebarnya. Keduanya bisa diketik atau diisi lewat Suggestion.

fields.label: Grain direction
fields.en: Paper grain direction: along the dieline length, along the dieline width, or no grain constraint.
fields.id: Arah serat kertas: searah panjang dieline, searah lebar dieline, atau tanpa batasan serat.

fields.label: Printing machine
fields.en: Printing machine picked from the machine master. Its bed size can limit the canvas.
fields.id: Mesin cetak yang dipilih dari master mesin. Ukuran mejanya bisa membatasi canvas.

fields.label: Die-cut machine (plong / pond)
fields.en: Die-cutting machine picked from the machine master. Its bed size can limit the canvas.
fields.id: Mesin plong yang dipilih dari master mesin. Ukuran mejanya bisa membatasi canvas.

fields.label: Market plano size
fields.en: Standard plano sheet size. Calculate Plano picks the most economical one; Custom L and Custom W with Use custom plano set your own size.
fields.id: Ukuran lembar plano standar. Calculate Plano memilih yang paling hemat; Custom L dan Custom W dengan Use custom plano untuk ukuran sendiri.

fields.label: Qty order (pcs)
fields.en: Calculator: type pcs to see the plano sheets needed, or switch to PLANO to PCS. Only an estimate for planning.
fields.id: Kalkulator: ketik pcs untuk melihat lembar plano yang dibutuhkan, atau ganti ke PLANO ke PCS. Hanya perkiraan untuk perencanaan.

fields.label: Bill of Material
fields.en: Materials per part with brand, specification, requirement per print sheet and warehouse stock. A row without stock can create a purchase request.
fields.id: Bahan per part dengan merek, spesifikasi, kebutuhan per lembar cetak dan stok gudang. Baris yang stoknya kurang bisa membuat permintaan pembelian.

fields.label: Ink Configuration
fields.en: Ink per unit and pass: ink name (for example Pantone), colour and coverage percent.
fields.id: Tinta per unit dan pass: nama tinta (misalnya Pantone), warna dan persen tutupan.

fields.label: Bill of Process
fields.en: Ordered production steps with process, machine, target per hour, waste and tolerance. A step can be sent to a subcontractor.
fields.id: Urutan langkah produksi dengan proses, mesin, target per jam, waste dan toleransi. Satu langkah bisa dikirim ke subkon.

fields.label: Artwork asset
fields.en: Upload an artwork file (image, pdf, ai, svg). Separate dieline uploads a structural dieline file.
fields.id: Unggah file artwork (gambar, pdf, ai, svg). Separate dieline untuk mengunggah file dieline struktural.

title: Pro-Dev Revise

purpose.en: Product development desk for Revise inquiries confirmed by Sales. Same workbench as Pro-Dev New, plus the list of what changed from the parent product so you redo only what is affected.
purpose.id: Meja pengembangan produk untuk inquiry Revise yang sudah di-Confirm Sales. Workbench sama dengan Pro-Dev New, ditambah daftar perubahan dari produk induk agar Anda hanya mengulang yang terdampak.

keywords: prodev revise, pro-dev revise, revisi, perubahan spesifikasi, imposition ulang, layout revisi, master card revisi, produk turunan

steps.en: Open the list; the default filter To Do shows revisions confirmed by Sales whose Pro-Dev is not finished.
steps.id: Buka daftar; filter bawaan To Do menampilkan revisi yang sudah di-Confirm Sales dan Pro-Dev-nya belum selesai.

steps.en: Double-click a row. The workbench opens for the first part not yet Confirmed. Read the table Revision: what changed from the parent product.
steps.id: Klik dua kali satu baris. Workbench terbuka untuk part pertama yang belum Confirmed. Baca tabel Revision: what changed from the parent product.

steps.en: Redo what the table marks as repeated in Pro-Dev: imposition, canvas, plano, BOM, ink and process of the affected parts.
steps.id: Ulangi yang ditandai tabel untuk diulang di Pro-Dev: imposition, canvas, plano, BOM, tinta dan proses pada part yang terdampak.

steps.en: On the Part & Dieline tab dimensions, flat size or artwork can still be adjusted, then Save.
steps.id: Di tab Part & Dieline dimensi, bentangan atau artwork masih bisa disesuaikan, lalu Save.

steps.en: Click Save and Confirm for each part. When every part is Confirmed the revision is Done and moves to Pro-Cost Revise.
steps.id: Klik Save dan Confirm untuk tiap part. Bila semua part Confirmed, revisi berstatus Done dan pindah ke Pro-Cost Revise.

fields.label: Inquiry No. / Customer
fields.en: Revision inquiry number with the customer name (list column).
fields.id: Nomor inquiry revisi beserta nama customer (kolom daftar).

fields.label: Work
fields.en: To Do while some part is not Confirmed; Done when every part is Confirmed. Also a filter.
fields.id: To Do selama masih ada part yang belum Confirmed; Done bila semua part Confirmed. Bisa dipakai sebagai filter.

fields.label: Revision: what changed from the parent product
fields.en: Table of changed fields with before and after values and where they must be redone. It comes from Inquiry Revise.
fields.id: Tabel field yang berubah dengan nilai sebelum dan sesudah serta di mana harus diulang. Berasal dari Inquiry Revise.

fields.label: 1. Number of Ups
fields.en: Number of ups on the sheet: automatic maximum, or a manual target. See Pro-Dev New for the other imposition fields.
fields.id: Jumlah up di lembar: maksimum otomatis, atau target manual. Lihat Pro-Dev New untuk isian imposition lainnya.

fields.label: Canvas limit
fields.en: Custom, Press bed, Die-cut bed (Pond) or Press + Die-cut. Decides which machine bed limits the canvas.
fields.id: Custom, Press bed, Die-cut bed (Pond) atau Press + Die-cut. Menentukan meja mesin mana yang membatasi canvas.

fields.label: Printing machine and Die-cutting machine
fields.en: Machines picked from the machine master for printing and die-cutting.
fields.id: Mesin cetak dan mesin plong yang dipilih dari master mesin.

fields.label: Market plano size
fields.en: Plano sheet size, chosen by Calculate Plano or set as a custom size.
fields.id: Ukuran lembar plano, dipilih lewat Calculate Plano atau diatur sebagai ukuran sendiri.

fields.label: Bill of Material, Ink Configuration, Bill of Process
fields.en: Materials, inks and production steps of the part. Check them again where the revision changed material, colour or process.
fields.id: Bahan, tinta dan langkah produksi part. Cek ulang bila revisi mengubah bahan, warna atau proses.

fields.label: Confirmed by Pro-Dev
fields.en: Date Pro-Dev confirmed all parts (list column).
fields.id: Tanggal Pro-Dev meng-Confirm semua part (kolom daftar).

title: Pro-Dev Manual

purpose.en: Product development without an inquiry: work on a part that is not linked to any inquiry (manual mode), for example from the Master Card. Same workbench as Pro-Dev New.
purpose.id: Pengembangan produk tanpa inquiry: mengerjakan part yang tidak terhubung ke inquiry mana pun (mode manual), misalnya dari Master Card. Workbench sama dengan Pro-Dev New.

keywords: prodev manual, pro-dev manual, imposition manual, part tanpa inquiry, standalone, master card, layout manual, plano

steps.en: Open the list of parts that do not come from an inquiry. Search by part or product name or code, or filter by Customer and Status Layout.
steps.id: Buka daftar part yang tidak berasal dari inquiry. Cari lewat nama atau kode part atau produk, atau filter Customer dan Status Layout.

steps.en: Double-click a part to open the Pro-Dev workbench. There is no + New Record here.
steps.id: Klik dua kali satu part untuk membuka workbench Pro-Dev. Di sini tidak ada + New Record.

steps.en: On the Imposition tab set ups, gap, canvas limit and size, machines and plano; use Suggestion, Calculate Plano or Auto Nesting if helpful.
steps.id: Di tab Imposition atur up, gap, canvas limit dan ukuran, mesin dan plano; pakai Suggestion, Calculate Plano atau Auto Nesting bila membantu.

steps.en: Fill Bill of Material, Ink Configuration and Bill of Process.
steps.id: Isi Bill of Material, Ink Configuration dan Bill of Process.

steps.en: Click Save, then Confirm. The Status Layout becomes CONFIRMED. A manual part cannot replace artwork on the Part & Dieline tab.
steps.id: Klik Save, lalu Confirm. Status Layout menjadi CONFIRMED. Part manual belum bisa mengganti artwork di tab Part & Dieline.

fields.label: Master Card / Customer
fields.en: Master card code (or part code) with the customer name (list column).
fields.id: Kode master card (atau kode part) beserta nama customer (kolom daftar).

fields.label: Part
fields.en: Name of the part (list column).
fields.id: Nama part (kolom daftar).

fields.label: Product
fields.en: Name of the Master Product the part belongs to (list column).
fields.id: Nama Master Product tempat part ini berada (kolom daftar).

fields.label: Last Updated
fields.en: Date the part was last changed (list column).
fields.id: Tanggal part terakhir diubah (kolom daftar).

fields.label: Layout Status
fields.en: BELUM MULAI (no layout yet), DRAFT (saved) or CONFIRMED. Filter Not Confirmed shows the first two.
fields.id: BELUM MULAI (belum ada layout), DRAFT (tersimpan) atau CONFIRMED. Filter Not Confirmed menampilkan dua status pertama.

fields.label: Auto Up / Target up (manual)
fields.en: Automatic maximum ups, or a manual target number of ups on the sheet.
fields.id: Jumlah up maksimum otomatis, atau target jumlah up manual di lembar.

fields.label: Gap
fields.en: Distance between artworks or dielines on the sheet, in cm.
fields.id: Jarak antar artwork atau dieline di lembar, dalam cm.

fields.label: Canvas limit
fields.en: Custom, Press bed, Die-cut bed (Pond) or Press + Die-cut. Length (cm) and Width (cm) show the canvas size.
fields.id: Custom, Press bed, Die-cut bed (Pond) atau Press + Die-cut. Length (cm) dan Width (cm) menunjukkan ukuran canvas.

fields.label: Grain direction
fields.en: Paper grain direction relative to the dieline, or no constraint.
fields.id: Arah serat kertas terhadap dieline, atau tanpa batasan.

fields.label: Printing machine and Die-cutting machine
fields.en: Machines picked from the machine master for printing and die-cutting.
fields.id: Mesin cetak dan mesin plong yang dipilih dari master mesin.

fields.label: Market plano size
fields.en: Standard plano size, or a custom plano with Custom L and Custom W.
fields.id: Ukuran plano standar, atau plano sendiri lewat Custom L dan Custom W.

fields.label: Bill of Material, Ink Configuration, Bill of Process
fields.en: Materials, inks and ordered production steps of the part. They are later used by Pro-Cost.
fields.id: Bahan, tinta dan urutan langkah produksi part. Dipakai Pro-Cost setelahnya.

title: Pro-Cost New

purpose.en: Costing desk for New inquiries finished by Pro-Dev: calculate the cost and the price per qty tier, send it for approval, and publish the price to Sales. Cost details are seen only by Costing staff and directors.
purpose.id: Meja costing untuk inquiry New yang sudah selesai di Pro-Dev: menghitung biaya dan harga per jenjang qty, mengajukan persetujuan, lalu mempublish harga ke Sales. Rincian biaya hanya dilihat staf Costing dan direksi.

keywords: pro-cost, procost, costing, hpp, kalkulasi harga, harga jual, publish harga, hitung, submit ke direksi, jenjang qty, costing hub

steps.en: Open the list. The default filter To Do shows inquiries whose price is not published yet. Costing shows how far each costing is.
steps.id: Buka daftar. Filter bawaan To Do menampilkan inquiry yang harganya belum dipublish. Kolom Costing menunjukkan sejauh mana tiap costing.

steps.en: Double-click a row to open the costing of the inquiry. Switch between parts with the part numbers; check each specification and whether it takes data from Pro-Dev (Ambil Data) or Manual.
steps.id: Klik dua kali satu baris untuk membuka costing inquiry. Pindah antar part lewat nomor part; cek spesifikasinya dan apakah datanya dari Pro-Dev (Ambil Data) atau Manual.

steps.en: Fill or adjust the cost parameters of each part. Use + Part Manual for a part that has no Pro-Dev layout.
steps.id: Isi atau sesuaikan parameter biaya tiap part. Pakai + Part Manual untuk part yang belum punya layout Pro-Dev.

steps.en: Click Hitung to calculate the cost and the price of every qty tier. The status becomes CALCULATED.
steps.id: Klik Hitung untuk menghitung biaya dan harga tiap jenjang qty. Status menjadi CALCULATED.

steps.en: Click Submit ke Direksi. The status becomes PENDING_APPROVAL.
steps.id: Klik Submit ke Direksi. Status menjadi PENDING_APPROVAL.

steps.en: A director or administrator clicks Publish (Direksi). The price is released to Sales, the status is PUBLISHED and the inquiry is Ready to Quote.
steps.id: Direksi atau administrator mengklik Publish (Direksi). Harga dibuka untuk Sales, status PUBLISHED dan inquiry menjadi Ready to Quote.

fields.label: Inquiry No. / Customer
fields.en: Inquiry number with the customer name (list column).
fields.id: Nomor inquiry beserta nama customer (kolom daftar).

fields.label: Received
fields.en: Date the inquiry reached Pro-Cost, that is when Pro-Dev confirmed it.
fields.id: Tanggal inquiry masuk ke Pro-Cost, yaitu saat Pro-Dev meng-Confirm.

fields.label: Costing
fields.en: Costing status: NOT STARTED, DRAFT, CALCULATED, PENDING_APPROVAL or PUBLISHED. Also a filter.
fields.id: Status costing: NOT STARTED, DRAFT, CALCULATED, PENDING_APPROVAL atau PUBLISHED. Bisa dipakai sebagai filter.

fields.label: Work
fields.en: To Do until the costing is published, then Done.
fields.id: To Do sampai costing dipublish, lalu Done.

fields.label: Published
fields.en: Date the price was published.
fields.id: Tanggal harga dipublish.

fields.label: Ambil Data (ProDev) / Manual
fields.en: Switch per part. Ambil Data takes the geometry from the Confirmed Pro-Dev layout; Manual lets the officer enter every value. Both feed the same costing engine.
fields.id: Saklar per part. Ambil Data mengambil geometri dari layout Pro-Dev yang Confirmed; Manual memungkinkan petugas mengisi semua nilai. Keduanya memakai mesin costing yang sama.

fields.label: Product Specification and Dynamic Parameters
fields.en: Part name, part type, qty per set, material grammage and the process parameters of the part. Rates come from the master data; the officer can override them.
fields.id: Nama part, tipe part, qty per set, gramatur bahan dan parameter proses part. Tarif berasal dari data master; petugas bisa menggantinya.

fields.label: Hitung
fields.en: Button that calculates cost and price of every tier. The result stays hidden from users without costing rights.
fields.id: Tombol yang menghitung biaya dan harga tiap jenjang. Hasilnya tersembunyi bagi pengguna tanpa hak costing.

fields.label: Submit ke Direksi
fields.en: Button that sends a CALCULATED costing for approval. It stays disabled until the costing is calculated.
fields.id: Tombol yang mengirim costing CALCULATED untuk persetujuan. Tetap nonaktif sebelum costing dihitung.

fields.label: Publish (Direksi)
fields.en: Button for directors and administrators only. It works only on a PENDING_APPROVAL costing and releases the selling price to Sales.
fields.id: Tombol khusus direksi dan administrator. Hanya bekerja pada costing PENDING_APPROVAL dan membuka harga jual untuk Sales.

fields.label: + Quotation
fields.en: Adds this inquiry to a quotation draft of the same customer and opens that quotation.
fields.id: Memasukkan inquiry ini ke draft quotation customer yang sama dan membuka quotation tersebut.

title: Pro-Cost Revise

purpose.en: Costing desk for Revise inquiries finished by Pro-Dev: calculate cost and price of the changed product, send for approval and publish. The revision differences are shown so you recheck what changed.
purpose.id: Meja costing untuk inquiry Revise yang sudah selesai di Pro-Dev: menghitung biaya dan harga produk yang berubah, mengajukan persetujuan dan mempublish. Perbedaan revisi ditampilkan agar Anda mengecek ulang yang berubah.

keywords: pro-cost revise, procost revise, costing revisi, hitung revisi, harga revisi, publish harga, hpp revisi

steps.en: Open the list; the default filter To Do shows revisions confirmed by Pro-Dev whose price is not published.
steps.id: Buka daftar; filter bawaan To Do menampilkan revisi yang sudah di-Confirm Pro-Dev dan harganya belum dipublish.

steps.en: Double-click a row. Read the revision differences at the top of the costing page.
steps.id: Klik dua kali satu baris. Baca perbedaan revisi di bagian atas halaman costing.

steps.en: Check each part and adjust the cost parameters where the revision changed material, colour, size or process.
steps.id: Cek tiap part dan sesuaikan parameter biaya bila revisi mengubah bahan, warna, ukuran atau proses.

steps.en: Click Hitung, then Submit ke Direksi.
steps.id: Klik Hitung, lalu Submit ke Direksi.

steps.en: A director or administrator clicks Publish (Direksi). The revision becomes Ready to Quote.
steps.id: Direksi atau administrator mengklik Publish (Direksi). Revisi menjadi Ready to Quote.

fields.label: Inquiry No. / Customer
fields.en: Revision inquiry number with the customer name (list column).
fields.id: Nomor inquiry revisi beserta nama customer (kolom daftar).

fields.label: Received
fields.en: Date Pro-Dev confirmed the revision and it reached Pro-Cost.
fields.id: Tanggal Pro-Dev meng-Confirm revisi sehingga masuk ke Pro-Cost.

fields.label: Costing
fields.en: Costing status: NOT STARTED, DRAFT, CALCULATED, PENDING_APPROVAL or PUBLISHED. Also a filter.
fields.id: Status costing: NOT STARTED, DRAFT, CALCULATED, PENDING_APPROVAL atau PUBLISHED. Bisa dipakai sebagai filter.

fields.label: Work
fields.en: To Do until the costing is published, then Done.
fields.id: To Do sampai costing dipublish, lalu Done.

fields.label: Published
fields.en: Date the price was published.
fields.id: Tanggal harga dipublish.

fields.label: Ambil Data (ProDev) / Manual
fields.en: Per part: take the geometry from the Confirmed Pro-Dev layout or enter it manually.
fields.id: Per part: ambil geometri dari layout Pro-Dev yang Confirmed atau isi manual.

fields.label: Hitung / Submit ke Direksi / Publish (Direksi)
fields.en: Calculate the tiers, send for approval, and release the price. Publish is only for directors and administrators.
fields.id: Hitung jenjang, kirim untuk persetujuan, dan buka harga. Publish hanya untuk direksi dan administrator.

title: Pro-Cost Recalc

purpose.en: Costing desk for Recalc inquiries: same product, new price. Recalc comes straight from Sales without Pro-Dev. Recalculate with current material prices, approve and publish.
purpose.id: Meja costing untuk inquiry Recalc: produk sama, harga baru. Recalc datang langsung dari Sales tanpa Pro-Dev. Hitung ulang dengan harga bahan terkini, setujui dan publish.

keywords: pro-cost recalc, procost recalc, rekalkulasi, hitung ulang, harga bahan naik, order ulang, publish harga

steps.en: Open the list; the default filter To Do shows recalculations confirmed by Sales whose price is not published.
steps.id: Buka daftar; filter bawaan To Do menampilkan rekalkulasi yang sudah di-Confirm Sales dan harganya belum dipublish.

steps.en: Double-click a row to open the costing of the inquiry. The specification is the same as the Master Product.
steps.id: Klik dua kali satu baris untuk membuka costing inquiry. Spesifikasi sama dengan Master Product.

steps.en: Check the cost parameters of each part, then click Hitung to calculate the new price per tier.
steps.id: Cek parameter biaya tiap part, lalu klik Hitung untuk menghitung harga baru per jenjang.

steps.en: Click Submit ke Direksi. A director or administrator then clicks Publish (Direksi).
steps.id: Klik Submit ke Direksi. Direksi atau administrator lalu mengklik Publish (Direksi).

steps.en: After publishing the recalculation is Ready to Quote and can go into a Quotation.
steps.id: Setelah dipublish, rekalkulasi menjadi Ready to Quote dan bisa masuk Quotation.

fields.label: Inquiry No. / Customer
fields.en: Recalc inquiry number with the customer name (list column).
fields.id: Nomor inquiry recalc beserta nama customer (kolom daftar).

fields.label: Received
fields.en: Date Sales confirmed the recalculation and it reached Pro-Cost.
fields.id: Tanggal Sales meng-Confirm rekalkulasi sehingga masuk ke Pro-Cost.

fields.label: Costing
fields.en: Costing status: NOT STARTED, DRAFT, CALCULATED, PENDING_APPROVAL or PUBLISHED. Also a filter.
fields.id: Status costing: NOT STARTED, DRAFT, CALCULATED, PENDING_APPROVAL atau PUBLISHED. Bisa dipakai sebagai filter.

fields.label: Work
fields.en: To Do until the costing is published, then Done.
fields.id: To Do sampai costing dipublish, lalu Done.

fields.label: Published
fields.en: Date the price was published.
fields.id: Tanggal harga dipublish.

fields.label: Sales PIC
fields.en: Sales person of the inquiry. Hidden by default; add it from the column list. Recorded as the basis for commission.
fields.id: Sales pemilik inquiry. Tersembunyi secara bawaan; tambahkan dari daftar kolom. Tercatat sebagai dasar komisi.

fields.label: Hitung / Submit ke Direksi / Publish (Direksi)
fields.en: Calculate the tiers, send for approval, and release the price. Publish is only for directors and administrators.
fields.id: Hitung jenjang, kirim untuk persetujuan, dan buka harga. Publish hanya untuk direksi dan administrator.

title: Master Card Collection

purpose.en: Collect the old master cards (Excel or photo) of existing products, correct what was read, and turn each card into a Master Product or an Inquiry. Used to bring old products into the system.
purpose.id: Mengumpulkan master card lama (Excel atau foto) produk yang sudah ada, mengoreksi hasil bacaannya, lalu mengubah tiap kartu menjadi Master Product atau Inquiry. Dipakai untuk memasukkan produk lama ke sistem.

keywords: master card, mastercard, kartu master, kartu produk lama, upload excel, foto kartu, make master product, make inquiry, koleksi master card, import produk lama

steps.en: Upload one or many master card files (Excel .xlsx with sheet MC, or a card photo jpg or png). Excel is read automatically; a photo is stored as an image.
steps.id: Unggah satu atau banyak file master card (Excel .xlsx dengan sheet MC, atau foto kartu jpg atau png). Excel dibaca otomatis; foto disimpan sebagai gambar.

steps.en: Use the status filters Incomplete, Ready, Master Product and Inquiry to find cards, then double-click a card. + New Record makes a card by hand, for example from a photo.
steps.id: Pakai filter status Incomplete, Ready, Master Product dan Inquiry untuk mencari kartu, lalu klik dua kali kartu. + New Record membuat kartu manual, misalnya dari foto.

steps.en: On the Data Kartu tab correct the identity, size and die data, and choose the Product Type so the dieline and size are checked.
steps.id: Di tab Data Kartu koreksi identitas, ukuran dan data pisau, lalu pilih Product Type agar dieline dan ukuran dicek.

steps.en: On Bahan & Proses match each card material to a master category. On Gambar upload the artwork per part. Click Save.
steps.id: Di tab Bahan & Proses cocokkan tiap bahan kartu dengan kategori master. Di tab Gambar unggah artwork per part. Klik Save.

steps.en: Click Make Master Product or Make Inquiry. A dialog asks only for the key fields still empty (such as design number, customer, product type, materials).
steps.id: Klik Make Master Product atau Make Inquiry. Dialog hanya menanyakan field kunci yang masih kosong (seperti nomor desain, customer, tipe produk, bahan).

steps.en: The card is then locked. Open the created Master Product or Inquiry from the buttons that appear.
steps.id: Kartu lalu terkunci. Buka Master Product atau Inquiry yang terbentuk lewat tombol yang muncul.

fields.label: Master card files (several at once allowed)
fields.en: Upload field for master card files: .xlsx, .xlsm, .xls, .jpg, .jpeg or .png, many at once.
fields.id: Isian unggah file master card: .xlsx, .xlsm, .xls, .jpg, .jpeg atau .png, boleh banyak sekaligus.

fields.label: Status
fields.en: Incomplete (key fields missing), Ready (can be converted), Master Product or Inquiry (already converted and locked). Also a filter.
fields.id: Incomplete (field kunci belum lengkap), Ready (siap dikonversi), Master Product atau Inquiry (sudah dikonversi dan terkunci). Bisa dipakai sebagai filter.

fields.label: Item Code
fields.en: Item code of the card. Read from the file; can be corrected.
fields.id: Kode item kartu. Dibaca dari file; bisa dikoreksi.

fields.label: Design No.
fields.en: Design number of the product. Required before the card can become a Master Product; filled in the dialog if empty.
fields.id: Nomor desain produk. Wajib sebelum kartu bisa menjadi Master Product; diisi di dialog bila kosong.

fields.label: Item Name
fields.en: Product name on the card (required).
fields.id: Nama produk di kartu (wajib).

fields.label: Card Date
fields.en: Date written on the card.
fields.id: Tanggal yang tertulis di kartu.

fields.label: Customer (master)
fields.en: Customer from the customer master. The text found on the card is shown as a hint to help you pick the right one.
fields.id: Customer dari master customer. Teks yang ditemukan di kartu ditampilkan sebagai petunjuk untuk memilih yang tepat.

fields.label: Part
fields.en: Whole card (Double Join = A + B), Part A only or Part B only. Cards of separate parts with the same design number merge into one product.
fields.id: Kartu utuh (Double Join = A + B), Part A saja atau Part B saja. Kartu part terpisah dengan nomor desain sama digabung menjadi satu produk.

fields.label: Joint
fields.en: Join type of the product, picked from the join master. Leave empty for no join.
fields.id: Jenis sambungan produk, dipilih dari master sambungan. Kosongkan bila tanpa sambungan.

fields.label: Qty per Pack (pcs)
fields.en: Number of pieces in one pack.
fields.id: Jumlah pcs dalam satu pak.

fields.label: Length L (mm)
fields.en: Product length in mm. Width W (mm) and Height H (mm) are the other two dimensions.
fields.id: Panjang produk dalam mm. Width W (mm) dan Height H (mm) adalah dua dimensi lainnya.

fields.label: UP per Sheet
fields.en: Number of pieces per print or die, for example 8 UP, 1/2 UP or 1 SET.
fields.id: Jumlah produk per cetakan atau pisau, misalnya 8 UP, 1/2 UP atau 1 SET.

fields.label: Die Code
fields.en: Code of the die. Die width (mm) and Die height (mm) are its size and are used to check the flat size.
fields.id: Kode pisau. Die width (mm) dan Die height (mm) adalah ukurannya dan dipakai untuk mengecek bentangan.

fields.label: Product Type (dieline)
fields.en: Dieline type. The system suggests one; changing it and saving recalculates the size from the die. Required to make a Master Product or Inquiry.
fields.id: Tipe dieline. Sistem memberi usulan; bila diubah lalu Save, ukuran dihitung ulang dari pisau. Wajib untuk membuat Master Product atau Inquiry.

fields.label: Description (card)
fields.en: Free note taken from the card.
fields.id: Catatan bebas dari kartu.

fields.label: Master category #1
fields.en: Master material category matching material #1 of the card (one field per material). A material without a match blocks the conversion.
fields.id: Kategori bahan master yang cocok dengan bahan #1 di kartu (satu isian per bahan). Bahan tanpa kecocokan menghalangi konversi.

fields.label: Product artwork
fields.en: Artwork image per part (jpg or png). It is placed on the dieline and carried to the Master Product or Inquiry.
fields.id: Gambar artwork per part (jpg atau png). Ditempatkan di dieline dan ikut ke Master Product atau Inquiry.

fields.label: Order qty (tier 1)
fields.en: Only in Make Inquiry. Quantity of the first tier of the new inquiry (required).
fields.id: Hanya di Make Inquiry. Jumlah jenjang pertama inquiry baru (wajib).

fields.label: Quotation deadline
fields.en: Only in Make Inquiry. Date the quotation should be ready (required). Filled as 3 days from today.
fields.id: Hanya di Make Inquiry. Tanggal quotation harus siap (wajib). Terisi 3 hari dari hari ini.

fields.label: Sales PIC
fields.en: Only in Make Inquiry. Sales person of the new inquiry, picked from the sales person master (required).
fields.id: Hanya di Make Inquiry. Sales untuk inquiry baru, dipilih dari master sales (wajib).

title: Master Product Market

purpose.en: Master list of product categories and their details with standard market sizes. It feeds Product Category, Category Detail and Standard Size in the Inquiry form. Maintained by the Pro-Dev officer.
purpose.id: Master daftar kategori produk beserta detailnya dan ukuran pasaran standar. Menjadi sumber Product Category, Category Detail dan Standard Size di form Inquiry. Dikelola petugas Pro-Dev.

keywords: product market, kategori produk, detail kategori, ukuran pasaran, standard size, master kategori, dus makanan, tipe produk, lookup inquiry

steps.en: Search by product market or product type, or filter by Product Type and Parent. Double-click a row to edit it.
steps.id: Cari berdasarkan product market atau tipe produk, atau filter Product Type dan Parent. Klik dua kali satu baris untuk mengubahnya.

steps.en: Click + New Record. First create a Product Category: leave the parent empty and give it a name. A category is only a group.
steps.id: Klik + New Record. Buat dulu Category Produk: kosongkan induk dan beri nama. Category hanya pengelompok.

steps.en: Create a Category Detail: choose the parent category, name it and choose the Product Type (dieline).
steps.id: Buat Detail Category: pilih kategori induk, beri nama dan pilih Product Type (dieline).

steps.en: Set the starting values for the Inquiry (print colours, qty tiers, paper and sheet material), and add the standard sizes with their dimensions.
steps.id: Atur nilai awal untuk Inquiry (warna cetak, jenjang qty, bahan paper dan sheet), dan tambahkan ukuran pasaran beserta dimensinya.

steps.en: Click Save. Keep Active ticked so the entry appears in Inquiry New; untick it to hide it.
steps.id: Klik Save. Biarkan Active tercentang agar muncul di Inquiry New; hilangkan centang untuk menyembunyikannya.

fields.label: Product Category (parent)
fields.en: Empty means this record is a Category (for example Dus Makanan). A chosen parent makes it a Category Detail (for example PPL).
fields.id: Kosong berarti record ini adalah Category (misalnya Dus Makanan). Bila induk dipilih, record menjadi Detail Category (misalnya PPL).

fields.label: Name (sales wording)
fields.en: Name as Sales say it, for example Paper Lunch Box (PPL). Shown in the Inquiry form.
fields.id: Nama seperti yang diucapkan Sales, misalnya Paper Lunch Box (PPL). Tampil di form Inquiry.

fields.label: Code
fields.en: Unique code. Made automatically from the name when left empty.
fields.id: Kode unik. Dibuat otomatis dari nama bila dikosongkan.

fields.label: Display order
fields.en: Display order in the lists. Filled automatically as the last order plus 10; can be changed.
fields.id: Display order di daftar. Terisi otomatis urutan terakhir ditambah 10; boleh diubah.

fields.label: Active (shown in Inquiry New)
fields.en: Tick to show the record in the Inquiry New form. Untick to hide it without deleting.
fields.id: Centang agar record muncul di form Inquiry New. Hilangkan centang untuk menyembunyikan tanpa menghapus.

fields.label: Change photo
fields.en: Photo of the product, image file up to 4 MB. Shown in the list.
fields.id: Photo produk, file gambar maksimal 4 MB. Tampil di daftar.

fields.label: Product Type (dieline)
fields.en: Only for a Category Detail (required): the dieline product type. The size columns follow this type.
fields.id: Hanya untuk Detail Category (wajib): tipe produk dieline. Kolom ukuran mengikuti tipe ini.

fields.label: Print colour
fields.en: Starting colour notation filled in the Inquiry, from 1/0 to 4/4.
fields.id: Notasi warna awal yang terisi di Inquiry, dari 1/0 sampai 4/4.

fields.label: Qty tiers (comma separated)
fields.en: Starting qty tiers for the Inquiry, separated by commas, for example 1000,3000,5000.
fields.id: Jenjang qty awal untuk Inquiry, dipisah koma, misalnya 1000,3000,5000.

fields.label: Material #1 Paper and Material #2 Sheet / SF
fields.en: Starting materials, picked level by level (Category, Type, Grammage/Spec, then optional Ukuran and Merek) from the material categories.
fields.id: Bahan awal, dipilih bertingkat (Category, Type, Grammage/Spec, lalu Ukuran dan Merek yang opsional) dari kategori bahan.

fields.label: Notes for sales
fields.en: Advice for Sales shown with this entry, for example which material to use for oily food.
fields.id: Saran untuk Sales yang menyertai entri ini, misalnya bahan untuk makanan berminyak.

fields.label: Size name
fields.en: Standard market size of a detail, for example R8 (18 x 18 x 6.7 cm), with one dimension column per parameter of the product type. Add rows with Tambah Ukuran.
fields.id: Ukuran pasaran standar sebuah detail, misalnya R8 (18 x 18 x 6,7 cm), dengan satu kolom dimensi per parameter tipe produk. Tambah baris dengan Tambah Ukuran.

title: Master Product

purpose.en: Register of finished products with their parts, materials, process, customer ACC and order history. Products are born automatically when a Quotation is WON; here Sales can only rename a product.
purpose.id: Daftar produk jadi beserta part, bahan, proses, ACC customer dan riwayat order. Produk lahir otomatis saat Quotation WIN; di sini Sales hanya bisa mengganti nama produk.

keywords: master product, produk master, product master, kode produk, no desain, design no, part, rakitan, acc digital, riwayat order, cabang revisi

steps.en: Search by product name, design number or customer, or use the filters Customer, Sambungan and Status.
steps.id: Cari berdasarkan nama produk, nomor desain atau customer, atau pakai filter Customer, Sambungan dan Status.

steps.en: Double-click a product to open it. There is no + New Record: products are created by the system when a Quotation is WON.
steps.id: Klik dua kali satu produk untuk membukanya. Tidak ada + New Record: produk dibuat sistem saat Quotation WIN.

steps.en: Change the Product name if the customer PO uses another name, then click Save. It is printed on the Customer Order detail and the delivery note.
steps.id: Ubah Product name bila PO customer memakai nama lain, lalu klik Save. Nama ini tercetak di detail Customer Order dan surat jalan.

steps.en: Click a part or an assembly in the product tree to see its dieline, mockup, materials, process, colours and finishing.
steps.id: Klik part atau rakitan di pohon produk untuk melihat dieline, mockup, bahan, proses, warna dan finishing-nya.

steps.en: Use the tabs Customer ACC, Order History & Selling Price and Revision Branch to see approvals, earlier orders and derived products.
steps.id: Pakai tab Customer ACC, Order History & Selling Price dan Revision Branch untuk melihat persetujuan, order terdahulu dan produk turunan.

fields.label: Product name
fields.en: Name of the product (required, the only editable field). Sales changes it to match the customer PO.
fields.id: Nama produk (wajib, satu-satunya isian yang bisa diubah). Sales mengubahnya agar sesuai PO customer.

fields.label: Customer (product owner)
fields.en: Customer who owns the product. Shown only.
fields.id: Customer pemilik produk. Hanya ditampilkan.

fields.label: Code · Design No.
fields.en: Product code given by the system and the design number. Shown only.
fields.id: Kode produk dari sistem dan nomor desain. Hanya ditampilkan.

fields.label: Finished size (L × W × H)
fields.en: Finished size of the product in cm. Shown only.
fields.id: Ukuran produk jadi dalam cm. Hanya ditampilkan.

fields.label: Parent (when derived from a revision)
fields.en: The parent product when this one was made by a revision. Shown only.
fields.id: Produk induk bila produk ini dibuat dari revisi. Hanya ditampilkan.

fields.label: Last order
fields.en: Latest order of the product with qty and date. Shown only.
fields.id: Last Order produk dengan qty dan tanggal. Hanya ditampilkan.

fields.label: Status
fields.en: ACTIVE (official, after Quotation WIN) or DRAFT (still in Pro-Dev). Also a filter.
fields.id: ACTIVE (resmi, setelah Quotation WIN) atau DRAFT (masih di Pro-Dev). Bisa dipakai sebagai filter.

fields.label: Digital ACC
fields.en: ADA when a Digital ACC is recorded, BELUM when not. Digital ACC is required before printing.
fields.id: ADA bila ACC Digital sudah dicatat, BELUM bila belum. ACC Digital wajib sebelum proses cetak.

fields.label: Dieline & Mockup, Material & BOM, BOP, Color & Finishing
fields.en: Read-only tabs of a part: dieline and 3D mockup, materials and inks, production steps, colour notation and finishing.
fields.id: Tab part yang hanya bisa dilihat: dieline dan mockup 3D, bahan dan tinta, langkah produksi, notasi warna dan finishing.

fields.label: Customer ACC
fields.en: Latest customer approvals by type, with date, person and channel. They are recorded and printed from the Pro-Dev form.
fields.id: Persetujuan customer terakhir per jenis, dengan tanggal, petugas dan kanal. Dicatat dan dicetak dari form Pro-Dev.

fields.label: Order & Selling Price History
fields.en: Earlier quotations and orders of the product with date, qty, selling price per pcs and result.
fields.id: Quotation dan order terdahulu produk ini dengan tanggal, qty, harga jual per pcs dan hasil.

fields.label: Revision Branches
fields.en: Parent, this product and derived products made by revisions, each with its status.
fields.id: Induk, produk ini dan produk turunan hasil revisi, masing-masing dengan statusnya.

title: Follow-up Quotation

purpose.en: Log of every follow-up Sales recorded on quotations (call, visit, WhatsApp, email), with the next actions that are due. Open it to see who must be contacted today or is late.
purpose.id: Log semua follow-up yang dicatat Sales pada quotation (telepon, kunjungan, WhatsApp, email), beserta tindak lanjut yang jatuh tempo. Buka untuk melihat siapa yang harus dihubungi hari ini atau yang terlambat.

keywords: follow up quotation, tindak lanjut, follow-up, telepon customer, kunjungan, jatuh tempo, lewat, penagihan jawaban, laporan quotation

steps.en: Open the report. Rows are sorted by date, newest first.
steps.id: Buka laporan. Baris diurutkan menurut tanggal, terbaru di atas.

steps.en: Click the stat Tindak lanjut lewat to see overdue actions, or Today for actions due today.
steps.id: Klik statistik Tindak lanjut lewat untuk melihat tindak lanjut yang terlambat, atau Today untuk yang jatuh tempo hari ini.

steps.en: Narrow the list with the filters Jenis, Hasil, Oleh and Jatuh tempo, or search by quotation, customer or notes.
steps.id: Persempit daftar dengan filter Jenis, Hasil, Oleh dan Jatuh tempo, atau cari menurut quotation, customer atau catatan.

steps.en: Double-click a row to open its quotation and add a new follow-up there.
steps.id: Klik dua kali satu baris untuk membuka quotation-nya dan menambah follow-up baru di sana.

fields.label: Date
fields.en: Date of the contact with the customer.
fields.id: Tanggal kontak dengan customer.

fields.label: Customer
fields.en: Customer name with the quotation number under it.
fields.id: Nama customer dengan nomor quotation di bawahnya.

fields.label: Type
fields.en: How the customer was contacted: Telepon, Kunjungan, WhatsApp, Email, Meeting or Lainnya.
fields.id: Cara menghubungi customer: Telepon, Kunjungan, WhatsApp, Email, Meeting atau Lainnya.

fields.label: Contact
fields.en: Contact person who was spoken to.
fields.id: Kontak yang diajak bicara.

fields.label: Result
fields.en: Outcome: Positif, Netral, Negatif or Tidak terhubung.
fields.id: Hasil: Positif, Netral, Negatif atau Tidak terhubung.

fields.label: Notes
fields.en: Notes written during the contact.
fields.id: Catatan yang ditulis saat kontak.

fields.label: Next action
fields.en: Date of the next action planned.
fields.id: Tanggal tindak lanjut berikutnya yang direncanakan.

fields.label: What
fields.en: What the next action is.
fields.id: Apa tindak lanjut berikutnya.

fields.label: Due
fields.en: LEWAT (date has passed), HARI INI (today), NANTI (later) or a dash when no next date was set. Also a filter.
fields.id: LEWAT (tanggal sudah lewat), HARI INI, NANTI atau tanda strip bila tidak ada tanggal berikutnya. Bisa dipakai sebagai filter.

fields.label: By
fields.en: User who recorded the follow-up. Also a filter named Oleh.
fields.id: Pengguna yang mencatat follow-up. Juga filter bernama Oleh.

fields.label: Type, Result, By, Due (filters)
fields.en: Filters to narrow the log by contact type, result, user or due state.
fields.id: Filter untuk mempersempit log menurut jenis kontak, hasil, pengguna atau status jatuh tempo.

title: Open Quotations

purpose.en: Issued quotations that still wait for the customer's decision (not WIN, LOST or Cancelled), grouped by Sales PIC. Open it to chase old, expired or never followed-up quotations.
purpose.id: Quotation terbit yang masih menunggu keputusan customer (belum WIN, LOST atau Cancelled), dikelompokkan menurut Sales PIC. Buka untuk menagih quotation yang lama, kedaluwarsa atau belum pernah di-follow-up.

keywords: quotation terbuka, open quotations, quotation outstanding, quotation belum diputuskan, kedaluwarsa, belum follow up, umur quotation, sales pic

steps.en: Open the report. Quotations are grouped by Sales PIC; the Grand total column is summed.
steps.id: Buka laporan. Quotation dikelompokkan menurut Sales PIC; kolom Grand total dijumlahkan.

steps.en: Click the stat Kedaluwarsa for quotations past Valid Until, or Not followed up for those without any follow-up.
steps.id: Klik statistik Kedaluwarsa untuk quotation yang lewat Valid Until, atau Not followed up untuk yang belum pernah di-follow-up.

steps.en: Narrow with the filters Sales PIC, Customer and Masa berlaku, or search by quotation number, customer or sales.
steps.id: Persempit dengan filter Sales PIC, Customer dan Masa berlaku, atau cari menurut nomor quotation, customer atau sales.

steps.en: Double-click a row to open the quotation, add a follow-up or close it as WIN, LOST or Cancel.
steps.id: Klik dua kali satu baris untuk membuka quotation, menambah follow-up atau menutupnya sebagai WIN, LOST atau Cancel.

fields.label: Customer
fields.en: Customer name with the quotation number under it.
fields.id: Nama customer dengan nomor quotation di bawahnya.

fields.label: Sales PIC
fields.en: Sales person of the quotation. Also the grouping and a filter.
fields.id: Sales pemilik quotation. Juga dasar pengelompokan dan filter.

fields.label: Issued
fields.en: Date the quotation was issued.
fields.id: Tanggal quotation diterbitkan.

fields.label: Age (days)
fields.en: Number of days since the quotation was issued.
fields.id: Jumlah hari sejak quotation diterbitkan.

fields.label: Valid Until
fields.en: Last date the offer is valid.
fields.id: Tanggal terakhir penawaran berlaku.

fields.label: Validity
