fields.en: BERLAKU (still valid) or KEDALUWARSA (Valid Until has passed). Also a filter named Masa berlaku.
fields.id: BERLAKU (masih berlaku) atau KEDALUWARSA (Valid Until sudah lewat). Juga filter bernama Masa berlaku.

fields.label: Grand total
fields.en: Total amount of the quotation including tax. Summed per group.
fields.id: Total nilai quotation termasuk pajak. Dijumlahkan per kelompok.

fields.label: Follow-up
fields.en: Number of follow-ups recorded. Zero means the customer was never followed up.
fields.id: Jumlah follow-up yang tercatat. Nol berarti customer belum pernah di-follow-up.

fields.label: Last follow-up
fields.en: Date of the latest follow-up.
fields.id: Tanggal follow-up terakhir.

fields.label: Upcoming follow-up
fields.en: Date of the next planned action.
fields.id: Tanggal tindak lanjut berikutnya yang direncanakan.

fields.label: Sales PIC, Customer, Validity (filters)
fields.en: Filters to narrow the report by sales person, customer or validity.
fields.id: Filter untuk mempersempit laporan menurut sales, customer atau masa berlaku.

title: Win-Rate Sales

purpose.en: Finished inquiries with their result: Won (became an order) or Lost, with the lost reason. Use it to see how many inquiries each Sales person wins and why others are lost.
purpose.id: Inquiry yang sudah selesai beserta hasilnya: Won (menjadi order) atau Lost, lengkap dengan alasan kalah. Dipakai untuk melihat berapa inquiry yang dimenangkan tiap Sales dan mengapa yang lain kalah.

keywords: win rate, win-rate sales, menang kalah, won lost, alasan kalah, lost reason, tingkat keberhasilan sales, konversi inquiry

steps.en: Open the report. It lists inquiries that ended as Won or Lost, newest first.
steps.id: Buka laporan. Isinya inquiry yang berakhir sebagai Won atau Lost, terbaru di atas.

steps.en: Filter by Sales PIC to see one person, and by Result to see only Won or only Lost.
steps.id: Filter Sales PIC untuk melihat satu orang, dan Result untuk hanya melihat Won atau hanya Lost.

steps.en: Compare the number of Won and Lost rows to judge the win rate. Read the Lost Reason column to learn why quotations were lost.
steps.id: Bandingkan jumlah baris Won dan Lost untuk menilai win rate. Baca kolom Lost Reason untuk mengetahui mengapa quotation kalah.

fields.label: Inquiry
fields.en: Inquiry number.
fields.id: Nomor inquiry.

fields.label: Date
fields.en: Date of the inquiry.
fields.id: Tanggal inquiry.

fields.label: Product
fields.en: Draft product name of the inquiry.
fields.id: Nama produk sementara inquiry.

fields.label: Sales PIC
fields.en: Sales person of the inquiry. Shown as (no PIC) when none was entered. Also a filter.
fields.id: Sales pemilik inquiry. Tampil (no PIC) bila tidak diisi. Juga filter.

fields.label: Result
fields.en: Won when the inquiry became an order through a WIN quotation, Lost when it was marked lost. Also a filter.
fields.id: Won bila inquiry menjadi order lewat quotation WIN, Lost bila ditandai kalah. Juga filter.

fields.label: Lost Reason
fields.en: Reason typed when the inquiry or its quotation was marked LOST. Empty for Won rows.
fields.id: Alasan yang diketik saat inquiry atau quotation-nya ditandai LOST. Kosong untuk baris Won.

title: ACC Digital / Proof Digital

purpose.en: Shows which products already have a customer Digital ACC and prints the Proof Digital sheet of a product: artwork per part, size, print colours and signature boxes. The ACC itself is recorded on the ProDev screen.
purpose.id: Menampilkan product mana yang sudah punya ACC Digital dari customer dan mencetak lembar Proof Digital sebuah product: artwork per part, ukuran, warna cetak, dan kotak tanda tangan. ACC-nya sendiri dicatat di layar ProDev.

keywords: acc digital, proof digital, acc artwork, proof print, persetujuan desain, acc customer, lembar proof, design number

steps.en: Search the product by name, design number or customer.
steps.id: Cari product dengan nama, nomor desain, atau customer.

steps.en: Use the filter row to list only products with No Digital ACC yet, or with Digital ACC done.
steps.id: Pakai baris filter untuk menampilkan hanya product yang No Digital ACC yet, atau yang Digital ACC done.

steps.en: Open a row to see the Proof Digital sheet of that product.
steps.id: Buka barisnya untuk melihat lembar Proof Digital product itu.

steps.en: Use the share bar above the sheet to print it, save it as PDF or JPEG, open the online link with QR code, or e-mail it.
steps.id: Pakai bar bagikan di atas lembar untuk mencetak, menyimpan sebagai PDF atau JPEG, membuka tautan online ber-QR, atau mengirim e-mail.

steps.en: Click Master Product to open the product itself; click Back to return to the list.
steps.id: Klik Master Product untuk membuka product-nya; klik Back untuk kembali ke daftar.

fields.label: Artwork
fields.en: Small picture of the product artwork; shows the product name when there is no artwork yet.
fields.id: Gambar kecil artwork product; menampilkan nama product bila belum ada artwork.

fields.label: Product
fields.en: Product name with its code, from Master Product.
fields.id: Nama product beserta kodenya, dari Master Product.

fields.label: Customer
fields.en: Customer that owns the product.
fields.id: Customer pemilik product.

fields.label: ACC Digital
fields.en: ADA = a customer Digital ACC is recorded for the product; BELUM = not yet. Production needs the Digital ACC first.
fields.id: ADA = ACC Digital dari customer sudah tercatat untuk product ini; BELUM = belum ada. Produksi memerlukan ACC Digital lebih dulu.

fields.label: Status product
fields.en: ACTIVE = product is in use; DRAFT = product is still being prepared.
fields.id: ACTIVE = product sudah dipakai; DRAFT = product masih disiapkan.

fields.label: REVISION NOTE
fields.en: On the sheet: the revision history of the product with design number and date, one line per revision.
fields.id: Di lembar: riwayat revisi product beserta nomor desain dan tanggal, satu baris per revisi.

fields.label: Inner SIZE
fields.en: On the sheet: inner length, width and height of the product in millimetres.
fields.id: Di lembar: panjang, lebar, dan tinggi dalam product, dalam milimeter.

fields.label: PRINT COLOUR
fields.en: On the sheet: the inks used by all parts of the product.
fields.id: Di lembar: tinta yang dipakai semua part product.

fields.label: INQUIRE & APPROVED BY
fields.en: On the sheet: who gave the Digital ACC, when, and through which channel, when it is already recorded.
fields.id: Di lembar: siapa yang memberi ACC Digital, kapan, dan lewat saluran apa, bila sudah tercatat.
